memories: [softly] You remember your first week with Arc. [pause] A Space for work. A Space for the side project you swore you'd finish. [warmly] And pinned tabs you never closed... because they were the work. Years of it. Quietly organized, exactly the way your mind works.
stalled: [wistful] Then Arc stopped moving forward. And you knew... sooner or later... you'd have to leave. [sighs] But starting over? Rebuilding every Space, hunting down every tab you forgot you saved? That's the part nobody wants.
choose-file: It finds your Arc sidebar on its own. Nothing is uploaded. Nothing leaves your laptop.
preview: You see everything first. Every Space, every folder, every tab... right where you left it.
profiles: Then you choose where each one lives. Work, in your work profile. Personal, in yours. Already signed in.
opened: [delighted] And just like that... it's all there. A new browser that already feels like home.
exports: Want to keep a copy? Save it as bookmarks, or a searchable archive.
passwords: Your passwords move straight from Arc. Handoff never sees them.
end: [warmly] You don't have to start over. [pause] Just... move on.
